description: Module #43: bot texts use the player's session locale. A enters with --locale deDE, status reports the language, A greets a bot (BOT names it, BOT_CMD is the module line), and the reply must carry the German line DE_RE. A ${var} in a match is matched literally, so DE_RE is the exact text fragment of the module's deDE line, not a regexp; BOT_CMD spells the bot's name out because a var cannot reference another var.

steps.title: a bot text comes back in that language

steps.note: the module's deDE line for the greeting
